reason: Approved source lineage is too wide/squat for the canonical 46x82 LP portrait footprint. A family-wide Pixel Snapper size that fits width collapses visible height to roughly half of the target envelope; per-era or nonuniform scaling is forbidden.
decision: Do not publish runtime sprites from this source set. Regenerate E0 with the tightened portrait silhouette contract, then rebuild E1-E5 lineage from the newly approved E0.
